interpretation: Observed return improves over the shared warm start, within-task shuffle is near-neutral, and sign-flipped return moves the margin in the opposite direction. H=3 improves over H=1, but H=3/5/full plateau and first-only is strongest. With only six held-out trajectories this supports label-direction causality but does not establish a trajectory-horizon advantage; a larger same-prefix delayed-consequence split is required.
